errors.text_span: stellt die Anzahl der FEUs in Millionen dar, mit einer Skala, die von 0 bis 20 reicht
errors.evidence: The y-axis represents absolute numbers on a scale from 0 to 20,000, not a count in millions on a scale from 0 to 20. The axis labels (e.g., 2.000, 4.000) use a dot as a thousands separator.

errors.text_span: in intakten Schritten von 1.000 bis 20.000 angezeigt
errors.evidence: The y-axis tick marks are in steps of 2,000, not 1,000.
The value for 2008 is 13,208, not 13.208 million. The description misinterprets the dot in '13.208' as a decimal separator (and writes it as a comma) and hallucinates the unit 'Millionen'.
The value for 2021 is 17,603, not 17.603 million. The description misinterprets the dot in '17.603' as a decimal separator (and writes it as a comma) and hallucinates the unit 'Millionen'.
This part of the sentence repeats the error of stating the values are in millions, which is incorrect. The values are absolute numbers.

errors.text_span: Die Balken für 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020 und 2021 haben Werte zwischen 13,208 Millionen und 17,603 Millionen.
errors.evidence: Listing all the intermediate years simply to state that their values lie within the range of the mentioned start and end points is redundant and does not add significant information. Describing the overall trend would be more effective.
